answer: A falcon-carried pigment proof stops fakes: after delivery the client seals the receipt in umber and hands its pigment code to a falcon courier flying to the registry in 12 hours. A bid above ten units needs three recent jobs; two peers match each code to its seal and log. A forged seal, a code that never flew, or one code on two bids burns a 17-unit bond; 100 fakes need 300 flown codes and risk 1,700 units. Their falcons already flew.
